Welcome to Aftergraph Discussions.

Aftergraph works on infrastructure and open research for verifiable intelligent systems: missions, bounded authority, durable execution, evidence, verification, and agentic institution semantics.

Use Discussions for questions, critique, reproduction reports, early RFC formation, and ideas that are not yet implementation-ready. Move concrete work into Issues and pull requests. Canonical claims, specifications, and evidence remain in the owning repository and exact source commit.

Start here:
- Organization profile: https://github.com/Aftergraph/.github
- Docs: https://docs.aftergraph.org
- Intelligence Systems Research: https://github.com/Aftergraph/intelligence-systems-research
- AIE: https://github.com/Aftergraph/aie
- Governance: https://github.com/Aftergraph/after-graph-governance

Contradictory evidence is welcome. A screenshot is not a benchmark, an agent saying "done" is not verification, and a discussion is not a standard.
